title: Wish Tough Chewer Had Size Options
text:
This is a fantastic subscription box! I have three dogs and would highly recommend it. I went with this box because I have an American bully that can destroy the strongest of toys in a matter of minutes. I only ever get him Tuffy toys and in the August box I got two Tuffy toys - a giant yellow crab and a medium sized lobster. They were fantastic! My dogs also loved the treats and cookies. My pickiest eater loved all three of the great flavors in this box so I had to give some to my mother to give her dogs and she will now be subscribing to the BoxDog monthly cookie box. You need to get this box for your dogs!

Edited to add: not a fan of the most recent box I received. I order the tough chewer because I have a 60 lb American Bully. I wish they had size options for the tough chewer. In my last box I got a very small rubber egg filled with bells that my doG will easily swallow and choke on if I give it to him. I will give this box one more chance, but if I get another small toy I will have to stop the subscription because it just isn’t worth it.
label: neutral
